items.t: Dual-clutch oil pump fault can cut drive power (recall)
items.job: Inspect transmission, replace if needed, update software

items.t: Sudden limp mode, won't go faster than about 20 mph
items.job: Diagnose powertrain fault codes and apply software updates
items.note: Cost depends on the cause; it is usually covered by the 5-year/60,000-mile warranty on these young trucks. A transmission replacement out of warranty would cost several thousand dollars.

items.t: Dual-clutch judder and hesitation from a stop
items.job: Transmission software update and clutch touch-point relearn
items.note: Clutch or transmission replacement is only needed if software and relearn don't help; covered by the powertrain warranty for original owners.

items.t: Dual-clutch transmission noise at highway speed
Turbo oil supply pipe can crack and leak (recall)
Tow hitch wiring module can short and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Install fuse and new tow hitch wiring extension
Secure or replace roof moldings with improved clips

items.t: Roof rail rattles or comes loose
Power steering assist can cut out (recall)
items.job: Replace power steering electric power pack

items.t: Tonneau cover won't latch or close flush
items.job: Repair or adjust tonneau cover latch and rails
items.note: Usually covered by the bumper-to-bumper warranty.

items.t: Oil in the intake from a misassembled PCV valve
items.job: Replace PCV check valve and clean or replace air cleaner
items.note: Done under warranty when covered by the bulletin.

items.t: Check engine light for engine temperature control fault
items.note: Covered by the 10-year/100,000-mile powertrain warranty for original owners.

items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors

items.t: Rough running or misfire from fuel injector faults
items.note: Usually covered by the powertrain warranty.

items.t: Can shift out of Park without the brake (recall)
items.job: Reroute center console wiring per recall
items.note: Free under recall 24V-877. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Side curtain airbags may be installed wrong (recall)
items.job: Reinstall side curtain airbags per recall
items.note: Free under recall 25V-809. Check the VIN first.

items.job: Update front camera software per recall
items.note: Free under recall 26V-316. Check the VIN first.

items.job: Update instrument cluster software per recall
items.note: Free under recall 26V-047. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Water leaks onto the front passenger floor from the windshield seal
items.job: Inject sealant into the windshield urethane gap (service campaign 9A6)
items.note: Free at a Hyundai dealer for covered VINs. The bulletin lists 0.3 hours and about $10 of sealant.
